title: Tiny, cute motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='4' fill='#2a1a4a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='14' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#8a8ab0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='7' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='3' fill='#a0a0d0'/>
  <!-- rear spokes -->
  <line x1='28' y1='59' x2='28' y2='85' stroke='#8a8ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='15' y1='72' x2='41' y2='72' stroke='#8a8ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='14' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#8a8ab0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='7' fill='#5a5a8a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='3' fill='#a0a0d0'/>
  <!-- front spokes -->
  <line x1='72' y1='59' x2='72' y2='85' stroke='#8a8ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='72' x2='85' y2='72' stroke='#8a8ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- swingarm / rear fender -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q24 52 32 48 L40 50' fill='none' stroke='#e85a5a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='18' y='60' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c0c0e0'/>

  <!-- engine block -->
  <rect x='38' y='54' width='20' height='12' rx='4' fill='#d0d0f0'/>
  <rect x='40' y='56' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f0f0ff'/>

  <!-- frame body -->
  <path d='M36 52 Q45 42 55 44 L65 46 Q70 50 68 56 L60 56 Q50 58 42 56 Z' fill='#e83e3e'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <path d='M40 50 Q48 44 56 46' fill='none' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 40 60 42 L62 46 L44 50 Z' fill='#5a3a6a'/>

  <!-- fuel tank -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='44' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='42' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ffb0b0'/>

  <!-- handlebars -->
  <path d='M66 48 L70 40 L78 38' fill='none' stroke='#d0d0f0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='38' r='5' fill='#ffe060'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='38' r='3' fill='#fff8c0'/>

  <!-- front fork -->
  <line x1='72' y1='58' x2='70' y2='42' stroke='#b0b0d8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little rider face on front (cute touch) -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='39.5' r='0.8' fill='#3a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='39.5' r='0.8' fill='#3a1a4a'/>

  <!-- motion lines -->
  <line x1='8' y1='56' x2='18' y2='56' stroke='#7ae8a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='6' y1='64' x2='14' y2='64' stroke='#7ae8a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='10' y1='72' x2='16' y2='72' stroke='#7ae8a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
